import sys

def solve():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    boundaries = [0]
    for i in range(1, len(s)):
        if s[i] != s[i-1]:
            boundaries.append(i)
    boundaries.append(len(s))
    ans = 0
    for i in range(len(boundaries) - 1):
        if (boundaries[i+1] - boundaries[i]) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
